basis: GASKET-UNSPECIFIED is referenced but not tied to a component manufacturer or specification.
The only material statement is a witness belief; no product specification establishes content.
Handling is alleged, but the handled component is not sufficiently identified as the asserted material.
No quantified dose, duration, or measurement is supplied.
The synthetic expert record supplies no causation opinion.
The record alleges liability but does not establish duty, breach, and causation.

non_claims: No product content, dose, causation, or legal liability is established.
No real product, person, worksite, or medical conclusion is represented.
